name: JW-SSD
description: Abstract Accurate sunspot classification is essential for assessing the eruptive potential of solar active regions and forecasting space weather. &#xD;We present JW-SSD, a high-quality multimodal benchmark dataset for fine-grained magnetic-type classification of sunspots. &#xD;Constructed from SDO/HMI SHARP 720,s data (2010--2023, Solar Cycles~24 and~25), JW-SSD comprises 36,553 co-registered magnetogram--continuum pairs from 2,507 active regions.
